metadata.name: Sediment geochemistry and grain‑size data from two German field campaigns (2018‑2019)
metadata.description: 21 sediment samples collected at a single site (51.4108 N, 12.0796 E, 113.8 m a.s.l.) during two campaigns (BH‑II 2018‑07‑22, BH‑rec 2019‑08‑12). Each record includes depth, TOC, BC, CaCO₃, pH, four grain‑size fractions, CPA, trace‑element concentrations, S/V, C/V (available for 8 samples), and δ¹³C/δ¹⁵N values.
metadata.spatial: Coordinate precision ≈1 mm (8 dp); points span ~0.3 km N‑S by ~0.34 km E‑W
